@gideon.sato Draft incident summary for Mateo's procurement team (Vantorre Hartford gate kiosks, Aug 3, 2026):

First reported: 10:42 AM. Both inbound gate kiosks showed a white screen after badge scan, so gate check-in was offline. Scheduling from the dispatch office still worked.
Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM. Trailer 8836 checked in and visible to dispatch.
Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM (posted 11:08 AM in #inc-vtg-hartford). Kiosk 2 was left powered on for reconnect logs. Ticket INC-4821 is still open for status-page access.

Source: #inc-vtg-hartford, Aug 3 messages from 10:42 to 11:08 AM. Times are as posted in that channel; I have not checked them against the gateway logs.
